sources.title: Open-source yolo11-number-operator model - Accurately identify numbers ...
sources.snippet: 🚀 Number and Operator Detection Based on YOLO11x This project provides a PyTorch-exported model using the YOLO11x architecture to detect numbers (0 - 10) and basic arithmetic operators (+, -, ×, ÷, =) in images.
